skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply macroeconomic theories to analyze the impact of monetary policy on macroeconomic variables in both closed and open economies.
Analyze the effectiveness of monetary policies of central banks in Vietnam and globally.
Develop independent research skills, group work, and presentation skills to convey knowledge through writing and discussing real-world monetary and policy issues.
Evaluate and solve complex monetary and policy issues.
Enhance self-study and research skills on monetary and policy issues in practice.
Work independently and in groups to solve assigned problems and present findings.
Collaborate effectively in group activities and presentations.
Effectively present research findings and engage in critical discussions.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and participate in class activities.
Apply problem-solving techniques to monetary and policy issues.
